subject: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request
messages:
From: Sam Rodriguez <sam@opentensor.org>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re doing well — I’m Sam, community lead at OpenTensor. We run an annual mentor cohort and maintain a small group of maintainers who steward core tooling across several OSS LLM projects. This year’s cohort runs from May 1–June 30 and we expect ~120 participants with ~10 maintainers mentoring.

We’d love to request two things from Redwood: a 60-day trial extension for the project organization (so our mentors can evaluate Redwood in real workloads during the hackathon period) and a one-time community credit allocation to cover sustained inference for the mentor VMs. Rough ask: $3k in credits (or equivalent token allotment) split across maintainers, plus an extension on the trial for the org-level account.

I’ve attached a brief list of maintainers and a one‑pager about the cohort. Happy to provide a short MOU if needed.

Thanks for considering — this support would make a big difference for open-source tooling reliability.

Best,
Sam
Sam Rodriguez
Community Lead, OpenTensor
attachments: maintainers_list.csv, cohort_onepager.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sam Rodriguez <sam@opentensor.org>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request

Hi Sam — thanks for reaching out and for the details. Jonas here (Community & Partnerships). This sounds like an excellent initiative. A few quick clarifying Qs to help us route the request for approval: 

- Can you confirm the total number of maintainers you need credits for (you mentioned ~10; is the ask for all of them or a subset)?
- Do maintainers need individual accounts or should we provision credits to a single org account and share access?
- Any data residency / compliance constraints we should be aware of for the cohort?

I’ve looped in Laura (Programs) who handles community credits and Vivek (Legal) for any terms check. If you can reply with the maintainer list attachment (CSV is perfect) and a short note on how you expect us to distribute credits, I’ll push this through our internal review today.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Community & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.inference | jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Sam Rodriguez <sam@opentensor.org>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Park <elena@llmtools.dev>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request

Hi Jonas / Laura / Vivek,

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming: we need credits for 8 primary maintainers (list attached as maintainers_list.csv). Ideal flow would be: Redwood issues a single promotional allocation to the OpenTensor org and we create sub-accounts for each maintainer to draw from, or you can issue per-maintainer promo codes — either is fine.

No special residency constraints; traffic will originate from mentors in NA / EU. We’ll publicly acknowledge Redwood as a community sponsor in cohort materials if that’s acceptable.

Attached: maintainers_list.csv (names + emails), cohort schedule, rough usage estimate (we anticipate ~120k inference tokens/week across mentors during peak hackathon weeks). If you need a signed MOU we can do that but prefer a lightweight promo code if possible.

Best,
Sam
attachments: maintainers_list.csv
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request

Laura / Vivek — forwarding Sam’s ask. Summary: OpenTensor requests a 60-day trial extension for their org + ~$3k in community credits (or equivalent token allotment) to support 8 maintainers during a May–June mentor cohort. They’re OK receiving a single allocation or per-maintainer promo codes. They’ll acknowledge Redwood in cohort materials.

My recommendation: approve a one-time community promo of $3,000 applied to the org, with a 60-day trial extension (org-level), and require acceptance of our Community Credits T&Cs (non-transferable, for project/org use only). I’ve sketched a short proposal (attached community_grant_proposal.pdf) and a redline of standard terms (terms_redline.docx).

Questions for you: Vivek, any legal concerns with the proposed wording? Laura, does the $3k figure align with current community program budget? If green, I’ll draft the promo and the short acceptance email.

Thanks — Jonas
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Sam Rodriguez <sam@opentensor.org>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Community stewardship: OpenTensor maintainer support request

Sam — good to meet you (virtually). We’re happy to support OpenTensor’s mentor cohort. Approved:

- Promo: $3,000 community credit applied to the OpenTensor org account (promo code below).
- Trial: 60-day trial extension for the org account, starting when the credit is applied.
- Distribution: we’ll apply the promo at the org level; you can create sub-accounts for the maintainers as needed.

Conditions: credits are non-transferable, expire 90 days after activation, and must be used for inference during the cohort period. Please confirm the org account email you want the activation applied to and accept the Community Credits T&Cs here: https://redwood.inference/legal/community-credits-terms.

Promo code: RW-COMM-APR26-3K

I’ve copied Vivek on the T&Cs; we’ll monitor usage and can provide a short post-mortem on utilization if helpful.

Sam — if that works, reply here with the account email and we’ll activate today.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: promo_code.txt
